 Some of the UFC's top fighters compete for gold when the promotion heads to Abu Dhabi for UFC 333. Alexander Volkanovski defends the UFC featherweight title against Movsar Evloev.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Whether you're watching on a smart TV, phone, or laptop, we'll walk you through the streaming options so you don't miss UFC 333.
 UFC 333 live stream
 Live Stream: Paramount+ 
 You can watch UFC 333 live on Paramount+ , with both the prelims and main card available to stream in one place. The best part: UFC 333 does not require a pay-per-view purchase — you just need an active Paramount+ subscription.
 Paramount+ plans 
 Paramount+ Essential (ad-supported): $8.99/month or $89.99/year
 Paramount+ Premium (ad-free): $13.99/month or $139.99/year
 Beyond UFC, Paramount+ includes a wide mix of live sports and programming, plus thousands of on-demand movies and shows, so you can stream events and entertainment on your phone, TV, or laptop.
 UFC 333 start time 
 Date : Saturday, October 24
 Time: 2 p.m. ET (12 p.m. ET for prelims) | 11 a.m. PT
 Location: Etihad Arena - Abu Dhabi, UAE
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement UFC 333 is in Abu Dhabi on October 24. The early prelims start at 10 a.m. ET, while the prelims are at 12 p.m. ET. The main card starts at 2 p.m. ET. The main event should start around 5:15 p.m. ET, depending on how long the undercard fights last.
 Volkanovski (28-4) is a two-time featherweight champion. After losing the belt to Ilia Topuria, the Aussie beat Diego Lopes twice. He beat Lopes once to win the title back, and again to defend it.
 The 38-year-old can still go and aims to prove that age is just another number against another dangerous opponent.
 "You can try and take me down all day," Volkanovski said to Evloev via The Associated Press . "Even if you get it down, I'm gonna be smiling as I get back up, and be back in your face."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Evloev (20-0) is a former M-1 Global bantamweight champion. He's won 10 straight in the UFC, beating Lerone Murphy to earn a shot at gold.
 Petr Yan and Merab Dvalishvili compete in a trilogy for the UFC bantamweight title. Merab (21-5) dominated Yan (20-5) in 2023, but the latter outworked Merab for the belt last December.
